text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x, y) ::: y binge-watches x.
Download(x, y) ::: y downloads x.
Share(x, y) ::: y shares x.
NetflixShow(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
Karen(y) ::: y is Karen.
BlackMirror ::: the show "Black Mirror".
Premises:
NetflixShow(blackMirror) ::: "Black Mirror" is a Netflix show.
¬Download(blackMirror, Karen) ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
BingeWatch(blackMirror, Karen) → Download(blackMirror, Karen) ::: If Karen binge-watches "Black Mirror", she downloads it.
BingeWatch(blackMirror, Karen) → Share(blackMirror, Lisa) ::: If Karen binge-watches "Black Mirror", she shares it to Lisa.
BingeWatch(x, Karen) → Popular(x) ::: If Karen binge-watches a show, it is popular.
Conclusion:
Popular(blackMirror) ::: "Black Mirror" is popular.
